reason: A task-protection and debugging plugin that preflights plugin injections, detects tool-call loops and excessive workflow recursion, reports interruption-related status, and guides agents without normally terminating tasks.

summaries.zh: 用于任务防护与调试的插件，可预检插件注入声明、检测工具调用循环和工作流递归，并提供状态查看与安全重启辅助。
summaries.en: A task-protection and debugging plugin that preflights injection declarations, detects tool-call loops and excessive workflow recursion, and provides status and safer restart assistance.

capabilities: Scans plugin source for missing service injection declarations
Detects repeated tool-call loops within a configurable window
Tracks nested subagent or workflow depth
Reports session status and restart readiness through a local API
Writes guardian events to a JSONL log
Injects guidance messages when loops or excessive recursion are detected
Provides a helper that refuses restart while sessions are running unless forced
